comparison: Original: a rounded sedan (arched cabin, soft rear, two full wheels on the body line) with a heart balloon on a wavy string tied to its rear deck, plus a heart decal on the cabin. Rejected drawing: a boxy pickup-like body with a flat roof step, the balloon heart jammed against the car with a thick curved tether, tiny r3 wheels, and no heart decal.
change: Rebuilt as a rounded sedan: rounded rear and nose, arched cabin (roof 16, deck/hood 26), r4 wheel rings on the body line with a sill between them; balloon redrawn as a Lucide-style heart (12 wide, mirrored) in the upper-left, tied to the rear deck by a thin wavy string, all parts 8 apart.
visual_review: Compared with the original; kept attempt-1-stroke-heart/ (solid two-stroke heart, too small to read as a balloon) for the record; final 48px light and dark previews read as a car with a heart balloon.
construction_references: Lucide car (wheels on the body line)
omissions: heart decal on the cabin (no clear band inside the cabin at stroke 4)
